stem: Voltmarkt's head of supply chain asks: "How many times over did the smart home category sell its average stock in 2025?" Which calculation answers this question?

options.text: Units on hand at year end / average weekly units sold
100 × (units sold - units returned) / units received in 2025
Units sold in 2025 / average daily units on hand in 2025
100 × days that closed at 0 units / all days in 2025
